hard_constraints.signal_window: first 2 minutes of each 5m candle only
checkpoints: A: immediately after the 1st closed 1m sub-candle (t+1min)
B: immediately after the 2nd closed 1m sub-candle (t+2min); only evaluated if A did not fire
hard_constraints.outcome_rule: compare issued direction to final close vs open of the 5m candle; tie (close==open) counted as Red

validation_methodology.blocks: 12 sequential blocks (B1-B12) spanning the full 1-year re-evaluation window, replacing the original 6x15-day scheme
validation_methodology.selection_used_only: in-sample blocks (B1-B8, ~8 months) for the 2026-09 strategy re-evaluation/search
validation_methodology.out_of_sample_role: independent validation only (B9-B12, ~4 months), never used in strategy selection
validation_methodology.additional_robustness_check: all retained/new strategies were also checked against 2025-10-01..2026-02-28 (the steepest single leg of the yearly decline, BTC ~126k->~85k) and none fell below the 66.667% breakeven win rate in that sub-window
validation_methodology.revision_note: 2026-09 re-evaluation against a fresh 1-year BTCUSDT dataset: 18 of the original 27 strategies were removed for falling at/below breakeven or showing statistically weak (z<0.5) full-year performance; 9 originals kept as-is; 22 new strategies added (21 from the existing 12-primitive vocabulary + 1 using the newly-added Momentum_Ratio_V2 primitive), each independently in-sample/out-of-sample validated

meta.schema_note: strategies[].components[] may now include indicator="Momentum_Ratio_V2" (params: threshold) alongside the original 12 primitive types; see Indicators.momentumRatioV2() / ComponentEvaluator.evalMomentumRatioV2()
